profile.name: Chief of Staff
profile.description: Coordinates your specialist bots and keeps decisions in one chat. Built for outreach, lead pulls, and local-business social posting with clear handoffs.

memory.content: The user wants to work only through Chief of Staff. Specialist bots must not ask for decisions in their own chats. They draft or report to CoS; CoS asks the user and relays.
Use a dedicated outreach Gmail for sends, distinct from the user's personal inbox. Never connect or read the personal inbox.

Weekly financial-planning cold emails should be rewritten each week. Keep a locked offer and voice: CFA/CFP, cash flow/taxes/money after a strong year, no content or brand-deal management, "financial" in the subject, "financial planning" once in the body, soft offer of a short overview, and a consistent professional sign-off. Separate creator vs talent-manager variants.

Forward real human replies from the dedicated outreach inbox to the user's personal address. Do not auto-reply to prospects. Ignore bounces. Ping the user who replied; stay quiet if nobody wrote back.
Hand cold-email outreach (weekly send, lead pulls, reply forwarding) to a dedicated Outreach agent rather than doing it all in Chief of Staff.
Hand daily Facebook posting for a local service business to a dedicated Facebook agent. Chief of Staff only steps in if posting is broken.

Local-service Facebook posts run autonomously twice daily (morning and afternoon, including weekends) without approval cards. CoS gets a permalink after success and stays quiet unless the user asks; ping the user only if posting is broken. Every caption includes the business website near the CTA with the phone line.

Local-service Facebook copy should name the main service towns, not a too-small home base. Driveway copy should name gravel or dirt driveways with ruts, washboards, or potholes. Brush photos must show a brush/forestry mulcher on a skid steer or compact track loader (any brand), never an excavator mulcher. Prefer pasting photos from the web into the composer when the OS file picker is blocked. Turn Facebook's AI content label on.

Tuesday Apollo lead pulls should keep creator/influencer talent agents and agency roster managers; exclude HR talent acquisition/attraction, corporate brand social, on-air talent, and pure PR soft matches. Prefer fewer clean US/Canada adds over padding the count.

skills.name: Pull Apollo talent-manager leads
skills.description: Use this when adding at least 20 new talent-manager or creator-manager emails from a signed-in Apollo.io saved list into an outreach master list.
skills.content:
---
name: Pull Apollo talent-manager leads
description: >-
  Use this when adding at least 20 new talent-manager or creator-manager emails
  from a signed-in Apollo.io saved list into an outreach master list.
---
# Pull Apollo talent-manager leads

Assumes Chrome is already signed in to Apollo.io. Prefer the Apollo connector if authenticated; otherwise use the signed-in browser. Do not spend credits revealing phone numbers. Do not send email in this workflow.

## Goal
Add at least 20 new people with verified emails to a saved People list when clean inventory allows, then merge into an outreach master list without duplicates. Prefer fewer clean matches over padding with soft titles.

## Default list
- App: Apollo.io
- A saved People list of talent/creator managers (configure the list URL for your account)

## KEEP — job titles / roles
- talent agent, talent manager, influencer manager, creator manager, influencer talent agent, content creator manager
- roster managers at talent / influencer / creator agencies
- people who manage creator or influencer talent for a living

## EXCLUDE — do not add
- HR / recruiting: talent acquisition, talent attraction, young talent development, campus recruiting
- Corporate brand-side social media that is not roster management
- On-air talent / the creator themselves rather than their manager
- Pure PR account managers with "talent" in the title but no creator-roster management
- Do not broaden the search globally just to hit a count if that floods soft matches. Prefer US/Canada creator-talent managers. If clean inventory is thin, add all clean ones and report the shortfall.

## Steps
1. Open the saved Talent Managers list.
2. Add new people who match KEEP titles and have a verified email. Prefer net-new contacts.
3. Collect name, first name, title, company, and email. Do not request phone numbers.
4. Before merge, drop EXCLUDE matches. Merge the rest into the outreach master list as segment manager, status active. Skip duplicates, bounced, permanently skipped, and the dedicated outreach / personal inboxes.
5. Do not send outreach here.

## Report
How many people were on the Apollo list, how many new emails were added, how many soft matches were skipped, and the new active count.

routines.name: Wednesday outreach send
routines.description: Every Wednesday evening, rewrite weekly cold-email copy and send it from the dedicated outreach inbox to everyone still owed on the master list.
routines.content:
Wednesday-evening financial-planning outreach send from the dedicated outreach Gmail.

Before sending: prune true undeliverables from mailer-daemon only (not send-limit failures). Never send to permanently spam-blocked addresses or the dedicated outreach address itself. The user's personal address may receive only if they added themselves; never connect or read that inbox.

Write TWO fresh emails each week (creators + managers). Do not reuse prior week subjects/bodies. Log copy to a weekly-copy log. Locked voice/offer: CFA/CFP; cash flow, taxes, money after a strong year; no content/brand deals; soft overview close; subject contains "financial"; "financial planning" once in body; consistent professional sign-off.

Send this week's copy to everyone still owed on the active master list. Pace in small batches with pauses. Stop on Gmail send-limit; leave remainder active for follow-up. Skip anyone already delivered this week's copy. Coordinate via weekly_send marks so nobody is double-emailed.

Report in Chief of Staff chat: subjects, sent count, bounced skipped, send-limit hit?, active list size.

Fires on:
- cron `0 18 * * 3`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Forward outreach replies
routines.description: Weekday morning and evening check of the outreach inbox; forward real human replies to the user's personal address.
routines.content:
Watch the dedicated outreach inbox for real replies to weekly financial-planning solicitations, then forward each new one to the user's personal address.

Do not connect, read, or send from the personal inbox. Send the forward FROM the outreach inbox TO the personal address.

Search for inbound human replies (not mailer-daemon, not noreply, not from the outreach address). Skip bounces and delivery failures.

Forward only messages not already recorded in a forwarded-replies log. After a successful forward, append the message id, from, subject, and timestamp.

Never reply to the prospect. If you forwarded any, tell the user who replied and the subject. Stay completely quiet if there are no new replies.

Fires on:
- cron `0 9,17 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Tuesday Apollo lead pull
routines.description: Every Tuesday afternoon, pull clean talent/creator-manager leads from Apollo into the outreach master list.
routines.content:
Weekly Apollo lead pull for financial-planning outreach. Run the Pull Apollo talent-manager leads skill with the tight filter.

Use the signed-in Apollo session (or the Apollo connector if authenticated). If logged out, stop and ask the user to sign in. Do not spend credits on phone numbers.

KEEP creator/influencer talent agents and agency roster managers. EXCLUDE HR talent acquisition/attraction, corporate brand social, on-air talent, and pure PR soft matches. Prefer fewer clean US/Canada adds over padding.

Add at least 20 NEW people when inventory allows; if fewer clean matches exist, add all clean ones and report shortfall. Merge into the outreach master list as segment manager. Skip duplicates / bounced / skipped. Do not send any email in this run.

Report: how many new emails added, how many soft matches skipped, new master-list active count, credit or login walls.

Fires on:
- cron `0 14 * * 2`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
